title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace: The MD-11 is HERE, but Beware this 737 SCAM!
description:
In this week's Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 marketplace update, we are looking at a massive range of quality—from the "pro-grade heavyweight" TFDI Design MD-11 to a product the community is calling a total scam.

STAY VIGILANT: We dive deep into the 737-100 by Scenery Creation. Despite the 4.8-star rating, this aircraft is missing interior shots and is facing serious community backlash. Watch before you buy!

We also have some incredible news regarding the Fokker F.VII (Free for a limited time!), the new Local Legend 24 CAC Boomerang, and the arrival of the Volanta Flight Tracker for Xbox users.
